FTNT.thesis_one_line: Leading firewall maker riding a real hardware-refresh and SASE upgrade cycle, but the stock is priced for far more growth than that cycle can sustain.
kill_criteria: Organic product-revenue growth decelerates to <20% YoY for two consecutive quarters
NTM P/E falls back toward its own 10-year median on flat-to-down guidance
Guidance cut versus the just-raised FY2026 revenue range of $8.02B-$8.18B
SASE billings growth decelerates sharply as Palo Alto/Zscaler/Cloudflare take share
key_adverse_facts: V1 systematic model flags the NTM P/E (46.99x) as 'excessive' with a bear-case 3y annualised return of -44.9%
Company's own reported $966M quarterly FCF could not be independently re-derived from XBRL tags in the time available
Thin consolidated equity base ($1.55B vs $10.86B assets) reflects years of aggressive buybacks, not a solvency issue but reduces balance-sheet cushion
data_conflicts: Reported quarterly FCF (~$966M per company release) vs. XBRL operating-cash-flow/capex series I could reconstruct - not fully reconciled
FTNT.confidence_in_thesis: medium - growth and margin trend are well evidenced from primary filings, but the reverse-DCF conclusion depends on how long the refresh cycle runs, which is inherently uncertain

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: Restated 2026-10-10 (DV18). The original dossier used a $139 price and $67-68bn market cap; the 25 Sep 2026 close was $173.46 and market cap $127.3bn. Programme basis: Ke 9.47% (5.17% + 1.040 x 4.14%), equity value $127.3bn, FCF after SBC $3.0bn forward ($1.97bn TTM): implied 10-year FCF growth is 16.0%/yr forward (21.7% TTM), against the dossier's own 16-20% base: in line at the low end of the base range, not 'above'. V1's 'excessive' label (implied 42%) uses a different construction and is not reproduced. The 16-20% base is generous against consensus FY1 growth of 11.3% and a decelerating guide; WATCH is kept on cyclicality and multiple (46x NTM P/E), with weaker valuation support than first stated.

FTNT.scenario_basis: Starting FY2026E non-GAAP FCF ~$3.2-3.4B on ~$8.1B guided revenue; bear = refresh cycle crests within 12 months, multiple compresses to peer median (~38x) on ~10% growth; base = growth decelerates to ~16-18% into 2027 with modest multiple compression from 47x; bull = SASE mix sustains ~25%+ growth and multiple holds; no dividend.

GILD.thesis_one_line: Dominant HIV franchise plus a genuine new twice-yearly PrEP shot, sized down because a single quarter just absorbed $12.9B of one-off charges from unproven oncology bets.
kill_criteria: A further material IPR&D impairment or discontinued-trial charge (>$500M) in either of the next two quarters
Net debt/EBITDA exceeds 3.0x on a consolidated basis once the cash-tag data gap is resolved
Yeztugo sequential sales growth decelerates below 15% Q/Q for two consecutive quarters
Biktarvy revenue growth turns negative YoY
A second Phase 3 trial failure/discontinuation in the oncology pipeline within 12 months of the Trodelvy NSCLC/EVOKE-03 discontinuation
key_adverse_facts: Q2 2026 GAAP net loss of $10.496B (diluted EPS -$8.45) driven by $11.2B acquired IPR&D expense (Arcellx $7.0B, Tubulis $3.1B, Ouro Medicines ~$1.0B net) plus a $1.75B Trodelvy NSCLC impairment after EVOKE-03 was discontinued

This is at least the second large one-off-charge loss quarter in the trailing 9 quarters reviewed (also Q1 2024, -$4.17B), suggesting a recurring pattern of large deal-related charges rather than a single isolated event
Long-term debt rose to $26.246B (2026-06-30) from $23.832B on a noncurrent-only basis a year earlier, while stockholders' equity fell to $11.829B, consistent with debt-funded M&A
data_conflicts: No V1 valuation row exists for GILD to reconcile against (checked v1_valuation_table.csv - absent)
Diluted EPS XBRL tag (EarningsPerShareDiluted) returns almost no post-2010 data for Gilead; Q2 2026 EPS figure sourced from the company release, not independently recomputed
Standard cash-and-equivalents XBRL tag is stale since 2022; current cash balance not independently confirmed, so a precise net-debt/EBITDA figure could not be computed this pass
GILD.confidence_in_thesis: medium - the core HIV franchise and Yeztugo ramp are well evidenced, but balance-sheet leverage and guidance-track-record could not be fully verified in the time available

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: DV19 2026-10-08: FCF-based re-test. TTM FCF after SBC $12.03bn = 6.4% yield on $187.1bn; at 9.67% cost of equity (5.17% Treasury + 4.5% ERP) implied growth about 3.2% (about 4.8% if $3bn/yr BD spend recurring) versus a low-to-mid single digit base: in line. Earlier text said below; verdict INCLUDE-SMALL unchanged.

GILD.scenario_basis: Starting normalized (ex-charge) quarterly operating income ~$2.4-3.3B annualized to ~$10-13B; bear = Biktarvy erosion plus a further oncology writedown and dividend held flat; base = low-to-mid-single-digit core growth plus Yeztugo ramp, dividend grows modestly, multiple stable; bull = Yeztugo becomes a multi-billion-dollar franchise and oncology bets show early proof points, modest re-rating.

kill_criteria: [DV21: FIRED at 30 Jun 2026, net debt $4,874M] Consolidated net debt/TTM adjusted EBITDA stays above 3.0x pro forma after the Q4 2026 release, or net debt rises above $5.0bn
Organic sales growth decelerates below 9% (the low end of the just-raised FY2026 guidance) in either of the next two quarters
GAAP-to-adjusted diluted EPS gap widens materially beyond the current ~22% (Q2 2026: $4.52 GAAP vs $5.52 adjusted) without clear one-off justification
Utility Solutions segment organic growth turns negative YoY (was +6% in Q2 2026)
A guidance cut versus the just-raised FY2026 range ($17.25-$17.55 GAAP EPS; 16-18% total sales growth)

GAAP EPS guidance was lowered in July ($17.45-$18.00 to $17.25-$17.55) even as adjusted EPS was raised; total sales growth guidance (16-18%) is mostly acquired.
